entities.text: SHASKIYA KARMACHARI PARISANGH Vs THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The petitioner before this Court is a society registered under the Provision of the Cooperative Societies Act, 1954 constituted for the welfare of Class- III employees of the State of M.P.

The petitioner is aggrieved by the inaction on the part of respondents to consider its representation,
which is made in respect of the proposed rules under the Food Safety & Standard Act, 2006.

The grievance of the petitioner is that it has sought clarification/inclusion of channel of promotion,
structure of organizations etc.
In this regard, the petitioner has submitted a representation on 27.01.2017, but the same is still pending.
In the circumstances, the respondents No.1 & 3 are directed to decide the petitioners representation after considering the report prepared by the Committee, filed as Annexure P/5.
An opportunity of hearing be also provided to the petitioners society.
It is made clear that this Court has not expressed any opinion on the merits of the case.
Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.

(SUBODH ABHYANKAR) JUDGE vc Shaskiya Karmachari Parisangh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 March, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/134404408/
